metaDescription: Shopify store for Hi Street, a men's shoe brand in Pakistan: shop by shoe style, fixed-price WOW Prices edits, size buttons and a size guide per product.
summary: Shopify store for a Pakistani men's footwear brand selling leather shoes, sandals and accessories.
overview: Hi Street sells men's footwear in Pakistan: formal and casual shoes, moccasins, loafers, sandals and slippers, plus belts, wallets and shoe care. We built Hi Street's Shopify store on a custom theme so a large catalog of leather shoes can be browsed by style, size and price.
challenge: Men shopping for shoes usually know the style they want, a dress shoe for work or a sandal for summer, and need to find their size fast. The range is broad, with several colors per design and regular sale and archive drops, so full-price, sale and fixed-price items had to stay easy to tell apart.
approach: The main menu lists each shoe style on its own (sandals, slippers, formals, casuals, moccasins, loafers) next to New arrivals, an Archive sale link and a WOW Prices menu that groups styles at one fixed price. Collection pages add quick tabs by style, a filter panel and a grid toggle. Product pages show the article code, the sale price against the original, color, EU size buttons from 40 to 45, a size guide and pay-in-3 installments.
outcome: A footwear store where a shopper can go from style to size to checkout in a few taps, with sale and fixed-price edits one click from the menu and the same layout on phone and desktop.

process.title: Navigation by shoe style
process.body: Each style has its own top-level link, so a shopper looking for loafers or moccasins lands on them directly instead of digging through one long shoes page. Belts, wallets and shoe care sit under an Accessories menu.

process.title: Sale and price edits
process.body: Archive sale is highlighted in red in the menu, and WOW Prices groups sandals, moccasins, casual and dress shoes at one fixed price each, so price-led shoppers have their own route into the catalog.

process.title: Collection pages
process.body: Collection pages open with a banner, then style tabs (slippers, formal shoes, moccasins, casual shoes, loafers), a filter panel, a grid toggle and discount badges on each product card.

process.title: Product pages
process.body: Product pages lead with the article code and price, then color, size buttons and a size guide link, followed by quantity and add to cart. The layout stacks cleanly on phones with the image carousel on top.

whyItMatters: Shoe shoppers buy by style and size, and many wait for a sale. Putting styles, price edits and the size guide in plain sight removes the usual reasons to leave before checkout.

faqs.q: What platform is the Hi Street store built on?
faqs.a: It runs on Shopify with a custom Hi-Street theme, using Shopify collections for shoe styles, sale and fixed-price edits.

faqs.q: Can Pixel2Tech build a similar Shopify store for my brand?
faqs.a: Yes. We design and build Shopify stores for footwear and fashion brands, including style-based menus, sale collections and product pages with size guides. Tell us about your catalog and we will send a fixed quote after a short call.
